name: Dumbbell Kickback
description: An isolation lift that peaks tension on the triceps at full lockout, with the upper arm fixed parallel to the floor. Performed with a dumbbell.
instructions: Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back and hold the weight, then raise your upper arm until it's parallel to the floor.
Pin that upper arm against your side — it stays fixed for every rep.
Extend your elbow and drive the weight back until your arm is fully straight.
Squeeze your triceps hard at full lockout for a count.
Lower the weight slowly back to a ninety-degree bend, keeping your upper arm still and parallel the whole time.

name: Barbell Lying Triceps Extension

name: Barbell Close Grip Bench Press
description: A narrow-grip press that builds triceps mass while the chest and front delts assist. Performed with a barbell.
instructions: Lie back and take a narrow grip on the bar, hands roughly shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the bar and hold it over your chest with your arms straight.
Lower the bar toward your lower chest, keeping your elbows tucked in close to your body.
Press the bar back up by extending your elbows, driving with your triceps until your arms lock out.
Keep your wrists stacked over your elbows and your elbows tucked — don't let them flare wide.

name: Assisted Triceps Dip (kneeling)

Press back up by straightening your arms until you lock out at the top.
Keep your shoulders down away from your ears and control the descent — don't drop fast.
